Tier 1 title (Schleicher notation).
sweh₂dwíh₁ neuter dual for honey+mead; m̥lités ablative of comparison.
gʷm̥yétes is PRS 2/3 DUAL; subject gʰósteyes is plural ('guests are coming') -> gʷm̥yónti (as later in the same dialogue).
tísrn̥s fem. for h₂ówis (f); kéh₂ileh₂es fem. for cows; ǵʰimés ablative with fear. 'thick milk' paraphrase for cheese.
h₂éwh₂os 'maternal uncle' (2nd sense); nos is a dative 'brought (to) us', English 'our uncle' is a free rendering.
gʷréws abl. of gʷéru 'spit'; h₁íh₂m̥/séh₂ fem. for ǵʰh₂éns (f).
Tier 1.
h₁íd neuter for mḗms; wĺ̥kʷoybʰos with fear.
bʰn̥ǵʰú h₂mélǵos 'thick milk' paraphrase; péh₂ureh₂es fem. for sheep.
ph₂trés ablative with fear; ssént impf. 3pl of ses-.
albʰéh₂ fem. for the cow (lexicon spells albʰós without h₂).
dedh₃wós is PRS 1DU 'we two give'; English 'they (the gods) give us cows and sheep' needs 3pl dédh₃n̥ti.
h₁ím masc. for h₂ébōl (m); English adds 'but'.
topéyonti is 3pl 'they heat'; the cook answers 'I heat stones' -> 1sg topéyoh₂. (minor too: aorist Hyéh₁km̥ beside present in a habitual description).
ḱóm = demonstrative acc. m. 'this' with skʷálom; ḱéyweh₂ fem. for the woman addressed.
wóyḱe = voc. of wóyḱos 'villager' (neighbour, stretched but ok); h₂éyeri for 'tomorrow' is the idiom.
stéh₂dʰh₁oybʰos is dat./abl. pl. and pérwōr acc. pl.: PIE says 'I drive the mountains for the herds'. 'drive the herd to the mountains' needs acc. stéh₂dʰh₁om (+ goal pérwōr or loc. pérunsu).
téḱneh₂ collective with 3sg verb kénketi.

lelóykʷe 'is missing' + h₁ésmōd 'from it'.

h₁íh₂ neut. pl. 'them' for honey+water; m̥dʰéwi loc.
h₂élyod neut. agrees with péh₃tlom.
mā́dsos is masc.: ḱóm, h₁ím, h₁éy piḱrós agree.
